mods.summary: 16/24-bit WAV, REC headroom, Auto Gain and sample-peak limiter.
mods.description: Public beta. Choose 16/24-bit stereo WAV at 44.1 kHz. Headroom 0/-3/-6/-9/-12 dB is live. Auto Gain and the -1 dBFS sample-peak limiter default Off and apply to the next REC; Auto Gain also enables the limiter. File-derived stereo meters have storage delay. Tested on one XDJ-AZ: headroom -6 dB, AGC tone/step/silence, limiter, 16/24-bit, a 34:52 session including a 7:30 track pause, and normal Disable/Reload/restore. Automatic splits, storage-error and power-loss recovery remain unverified. No true-peak guarantee or native48/96 claim. Exact firmware and AZ-MODS core 1.2.3+ only.
